_review: Nigerian Pidgin (pcm). NEEDS NATIVE-SPEAKER REVIEW before release: drafted to be simple and natural, not yet checked by a native speaker.

errors.generic: Something no work well. Abeg try again.
errors.network: No network. Check your data or Wi-Fi, then try again.
errors.offline: You no get network. Na wetin we load last time we dey show.

codes.network_error: No network. Check your data or Wi-Fi, then try again.
codes.server_error: Something spoil for our side. Abeg try again.
codes.throttled: You don try too many times. Wait small, then try again.
codes.login_pin_locked: You don enter wrong PIN too many times. Change your PIN or try again later.
codes.device_not_recognised: Abeg sign in again for dis phone.
codes.otp_invalid: Dat code no correct, or e don expire.
codes.otp_attempts_exceeded: You don enter wrong code too many times. Ask for new one.
codes.otp_resend_limited: Abeg wait small before you ask for another code.
codes.otp_delivery_failed: We no fit send the code now. Try again, or make we send am to your email.
codes.setup_expired: Dis step don expire. Abeg start again.
codes.request_in_progress: We still dey work on your last request. Abeg wait small.

codes.listing_unavailable: Dis place no dey available again.

welcome.title: Your rent, e don set
welcome.subtitle: See wetin you owe, pay your landlord safe, and keep all your receipt for one place.

auth.signUpSubtitle: Use the phone number wey your landlord get for you. We go send you code by SMS.
auth.acceptTerms: I agree to Homesika Terms and Privacy Policy
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in for dis phone with your phone number and your 6-digit PIN.
auth.noAccount: You never get Homesika account? Open one
auth.haveAccount: You get account before? Sign in

otp.title: Put the code
otp.sentSms: We don send 6-digit code by SMS to {{destination}}.
otp.codeLabel: 6-digit code, you don put {{filled}} out of 6
otp.resendIn: You fit ask for new code in {{seconds}}s
otp.useEmail: Send am to my email instead

pin.createSubtitle: 6 numbers wey you go dey use open Homesika. No use your birthday.
pin.mismatch: The two PIN no be the same. Try again.
pin.weak: Choose PIN wey hard to guess (no be 123456 or 111111).
pin.dots: You don put {{filled}} out of {{length}} numbers
pin.forgotSubtitle: Put your phone number. We go send code so you fit make new PIN. Other phones go sign out.

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.switchBody: Dis phone go comot from your account. You go need your phone number, PIN and code to sign in again.
lock.offerBioTitle: You wan open am quick quick?
lock.offerBioBody: Use your finger or your face instead of to type PIN.

home.allPaidBody: You no owe anything now. If new one come, e go show here.
home.notLinkedBody: Tell your landlord make e add your number {{phone}} for Homesika. Your rent and wetin you owe go show here once e add am.
home.findPlace: Find house wey you fit rent

charges.title: Wetin I owe
charges.oneLandlord: You fit pay only one landlord at a time. We don change am to {{landlord}}.
charges.emptyBody: When your landlord add rent or other charge, e go show here.

pay.successBody: Thank you. Your landlord don get the money.
pay.processingBody: Bank never confirm am yet. If dem don remove money from your account, e go show here by itself. No pay again.
pay.notPaidBody: Dis payment link don {{status}}. Dem no remove your money. You fit start again from Wetin I owe.

payments.title: Payments
payments.emptyBody: Money wey you pay, and the one wey your landlord record, go show here with receipt.
payments.receiptFailed: We no fit bring the receipt. Try again.

profile.title: My profile
profile.name: Name
profile.languageHint: Choose the language wey you want
profile.signOutBody: You go need your phone number, PIN and code to sign in again.
profile.findPlace: Find house wey you fit rent

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp messages
whatsapp.body: Make your rent reminder and receipt dey come for WhatsApp instead of SMS.
whatsapp.toggle: Send reminder and receipt for WhatsApp
whatsapp.stop: Any time wey you want, reply STOP for WhatsApp to off am.

help.title: Help
help.emptyBody: Ask about your rent, payment, receipt or lease. You fit write for English or Pidgin.
help.emergency: If na emergency, call 112 sharp sharp. Homesika no be emergency service.

suggestions.owe: Abeg how much I dey owe?
suggestions.nextDue: When my next rent go due?

help.notSent: E no send. Tap am make you try again
help.escalated: We don give dis matter to person. Dem go reply you for dis chat during work hours (Lagos time).
help.clearBody: Dis one go delete all your chat with Homesika assistant. You no fit bring am back.

find.title: Find house
find.maxRent: The highest rent wey you fit pay
find.maxRentHint: Leave am empty for any price
find.emptyBody: Try another area, higher rent, or any number of bedroom.
find.noSlots: No viewing time dey open now. Ask about am, the landlord fit get back to you.
find.name: Your name
find.booked: We don book your viewing for {{time}}.
find.asked: E don send. The landlord fit reach you now for {{phone}}.

bills.title: Pay bills
bills.homeBody: Airtime, data, TV and light. You go pay for each one as you dey buy, no wallet.
bills.howItWorks: You go pay for each thing you buy for checkout. No wallet, no balance to load. If we no fit deliver am, we go return your money by ourself.

categoryHint.cable_tv: Pay for DStv, GOtv, Startimes and others
categoryHint.electricity: Buy prepaid token or pay postpaid light bill

bills.phoneHint: We don put your number. Change am if na for another person.
bills.customerInvalid: Check the number well, then try again.
bills.meterFromHome: Na your meter for {{unit}} be dis. Change am if na another meter.
bills.discoUnknown: We no sure which light company your house dey use. Abeg pick am.
bills.noPlans: No plan dey now. Abeg try again later.

amountErrors.invalid: Put the amount for naira, like 1500.

bills.noBillersBody: Dis service no dey work now. Abeg try again later.

review.title: Check am, then pay
review.name: Name
review.feeAdded: Service charge of {{fee}} dey, so you go pay {{total}} total.

bills.historyEmpty: You never pay any bill yet
bills.historyEmptyBody: Airtime, data, TV and light wey you buy go show here.

order.checkingBody: E no dey pass few seconds.
order.checkFailed: We no fit check am now. Check your network, then try again.
order.awaitingTitle: We dey wait for your payment
order.awaitingBody: Finish the payment for checkout. If you don pay already, dis page go change by itself.
order.processingTitle: You don pay. E dey go now
order.processingBody: Your money don reach us and we dey send am now. E no dey pass one minute. If e no fit land, we go return your money by ourself. No pay again.
order.tokenHint: Type dis token for your meter. We don also send am to you by SMS.
order.copyFailed: We no fit copy am. Press the token hold am make you copy am.
order.receiptFailed: We no fit get the receipt. Try again.
order.refundPendingBody: We dey return {{amount}} to the card or account wey you take pay. E dey usually reach in 1–5 working days.
order.refundedBody: We no fit deliver am, so we don return {{amount}} to the card or account wey you take pay. E dey usually reach in 1–5 working days, depend on your bank.
order.expiredBody: You no finish dis payment, so dem no collect your money. You fit start new one.

errors.customer_not_found: We no see dat meter or smartcard number. Check am well, then try again.
errors.bills_daily_limit: You don reach today limit for bill payment. Try again tomorrow.
errors.bills_unavailable: Bill payment no dey work now. Abeg try again small time.
errors.order_not_payable: You no fit pay for dis order again. Abeg start new one.

repairs.title: Repairs
repairs.homeBody: Report am here. Your landlord go approve am, then Verified artisan go come fix am.
repairs.emptyBody: When something for your house need fixing, report am here with picture.
repairs.noLease: You fit report repair once your landlord add you to lease for Homesika.

status.approved: Landlord don approve, dem dey find artisan

priorityHint.urgent: E dey cause real wahala now

form.title: Report problem
form.descriptionHint: Where e dey, wetin dey happen, and since when?
form.photosHint: Picture go help artisan bring the correct tools. Up to {{max}}.
form.photosFailed: Your request don go, but {{count}} picture no upload. You fit add dem from the request.
form.emergency: If person dey for danger, or fire, gas or wire dey spark, comot for danger and call 112 now. Then report am here.
form.permission: Homesika need permission to use your camera or picture. You fit on am for your phone settings.
form.chooseHome: Choose the house wey e concern.
form.needTitle: Talk for small words wetin spoil.
form.needDescription: Explain small more make artisan come prepare.

detail.title: Repair {{reference}}
detail.verifiedHint: Homesika don check: ID, phone, address, two guarantors and one reference.
detail.noArtisan: Your landlord go choose artisan after e approve.
detail.noPayment: Homesika no dey collect money for repair work. Agree any price with your landlord or the artisan first.
detail.confirmBody: Confirm if e don fix, or tell us wetin still dey wrong. If you no answer, e go mark as fixed after 7 days.
detail.reopened: We don tell the artisan and your landlord
detail.rateBody: Your rating go help other tenants and landlords choose better artisan.
detail.cancelLabel: Why you dey cancel? (you fit skip)
detail.commentHint: Your landlord and the artisan go see am.
detail.autoConfirmed: E mark as fixed by itself after 7 days.

events.assigned: Dem ask artisan make e take the work
events.declined: Artisan no fit take am; dem dey find another one
events.resolved: Your landlord say e don fix

work.title: Work as artisan
work.introBody: Landlords and estates for Homesika dey give repair work to Verified artisans. Register, pass the checks, and start to get work near you.
work.steps: To get Verified badge you need: ID check, your phone number, your address, two guarantors and one reference.

apply.title: Register as artisan
apply.name: Your name or business name
apply.nameHint: Landlords go see am, like: Musa Plumbing Works
apply.areasHint: Separate with comma, like: Lekki, Ajah, VI
apply.addressHint: Homesika go confirm am. Landlords and tenants no go see am.
apply.years: How many years you don dey do am
apply.consent: I gree make Homesika check my ID, contact my guarantors and references, and confirm my address, to verify me.
apply.consentNeeded: Abeg gree to the checks make you fit continue.
apply.done: You don register. Now finish the checks.

work.suspended: Dem don suspend your account: {{reason}} Contact Homesika support.
work.availableHint: Off am when you dey busy or you travel. Landlords no go see you until you on am back.
work.checkedAll: All checks don pass. You don be Verified!
work.noJobsBody: When landlord give you work, e go show here and you go get SMS.
work.noJobsPending: You go dey get work once you don be Verified.

id.title: ID check
id.intro: Use ID wey get your name and picture. Homesika go keep am safe and use am only to check who you be.
id.photoHint: Make e clear, flat and for better light, with all four corners showing.
id.sent: E don go. We go tell you for SMS when dem check am.
id.pending: Your ID dey wait make dem check am.

people.title: Guarantors and reference
people.intro: We go send each person SMS with link make dem confirm. Choose people wey know you well and go answer.
people.guarantorsHint: Two people wey know you well, like family, community leader or your former oga.
people.referencesHint: Person wey you don do work for before, like old customer or landlord.
people.name: Full name
people.relationshipHint: Like: uncle, former oga, old customer

job.title: Work {{reference}}
job.addressAfter: You go see the address and tenant phone number after you accept.
job.decideLater: I go call make we agree time
job.accepted: You don accept. Dem don tell the tenant.
job.declined: You don decline. Landlord go choose another person.
job.started: E don mark say you reach
job.completeHint: Like: I change the washer and test the tap
job.photo: Add picture of the finished work
job.noPayment: Agree any price with the landlord before you start. Homesika no dey handle payment for work.
